description: Réseau de transport Mouv'enbus de l'Agglomération Provence Verte is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté d'Agglomération Provence Verte. Offre de transport en commun du réseau Mouv'enbus de l'Agglomération Provence Verte. Les données disponibles au format GTFS: lignes, arrêts et horaires théoriques de passage et jours de fonctionnement des 25 lignes de bus ainsi que des quatre navettes urbaines que compte l'Agglomération. Coverage: Communauté d'Agglomération Provence Verte. The portal shows the English title as "Mouv'enbus transport network of the Agglomeration Provence Verte" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Communauté d'Agglomération Provence Verte. Its keywords include bus, gtfs, mobilite, reseau, mouvenbus. The listing shows 4 download or service links in PDF, ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
